usage.source_scope: Official mesh-to-image rasterization, pixel-to-face, z-buffer, 2D instance projection, and object-visibility utilities only.
usage.project_application: For the next visibility-qualified L10 source, replace SceneNN reference-side envelope depth reads with z-buffer-visible target-instance pixels, depth consistency, and a visible-face plane fit while keeping candidate identity and query transfer fixed.
usage.modifications: Use the toolkit as deterministic visibility machinery for a door-labeled real posed source. Do not treat ScanNet++ semantic labels as functional entrance, exact public identity, arrival, or user completion truth.
usage.expected_effect: Reduce foreground-contaminated reference planes and improve exact-door Top-1, centroid-inside, median IoU, and world-centroid error without increasing wrong-door commits. Stop if the joint geometry/identity result does not improve; do not rescue with prompt, backbone, plane-residual, or threshold sweeps.

evaluation.claim_boundary: This plan creates no new L10 evidence or execution authority. Even a positive posed-source result would remain a real-data geometry/transfer result, not open-world door identity, phone-camera coverage, metric arrival, user completion, product benefit, or safety.
